metaTitle: Custom Ringspun Tank Tops | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom ringspun tank tops for your team or event. Soft, breathable fabric perfect for screen printing. Fast turnaround on bulk orders.
introHtml: Ringspun cotton tank tops offer a softer feel and smoother print surface than standard jersey tanks. The tighter yarn construction reduces pilling and keeps your logo looking crisp wash after wash. Ideal for summer giveaways, race events, or employee uniforms, these tanks accept screen printing and embroidery with excellent detail. The Unisex Bella + Canvas Jersey Tank is a popular blank that fits most body types and comes in a range of colors to match your brand.
heroAltText: Custom ringspun tank tops with screen printed logo on a soft cotton blend tank top
